slice: Independent red-team of Ender's M18 asymmetric Formation empathy stake before implementation.
sharedContext: The current device-local PartnerPerspectiveExercise asks a member to predict a synthetic partner's answers across six questions. Ender identifies that as mind-reading and false symmetry.

Ender's replacement has three shared axes with asymmetric prompts. Carrying side: What's in front of you right now?; What would make an hour of this worth it?; What you'd rather not hand over. Helping side: What you'd want to look at first.; What you'd need from them to be useful.; What you wouldn't take on.
Member name is Prepare for a real conversation. Internal words Formation, stake, packet, lane, and seat do not render.
Each side answers only for itself. In the single-player ghost walk, the partner side may be generated practice data only when labeled as generated and never attributed to a real person.
Comparison states are words plus geometry: Same read; Close, with a step; Not the same thing yet. There is no score, percent, match strength, green/amber/red, or compatibility verdict.
Visual break is a lay-up seam diagram: two pieces of stock meeting, offset, or separated across Scope, Bar, and Edge. Geometry carries meaning in grayscale.
State is device-local and scoped to one Possible Werkle. Text must survive reload. Completion never auto-shares. No timers, read receipts, waiting spinner, or implied response.
If Intake already supplied a Scope answer, amend rather than re-ask; source mapping remains an admitted dependency and must not be invented.
Hostile cases: no partner answer, one-word answer, cloned answers, professional-advice request, second device, long answer, and self-match.
390px checks require one axis per step, non-destructive back/forward, vertical reveal, no overflow, reload persistence, grayscale distinction, and 44px targets.
Ender's exact receipt hash is 191cc66114cdd8fc6bd79e0522faf8eeb2cf47e269d8c1a38b6f5abd52f8689f. Gate 05 remains HOLD.
